name: Rare Society
lede: In San Clemente, a two-storey steakhouse wraps Spanish Colonial arches around Las Vegas glamour. Platinum Electric heaters in its semi-enclosed spaces keep the patios open through the winter, without breaking the look.
data: Avenida Del Mar, San Clemente, California

hero.caption: Platinum Electric above the terrace doors under the timber-beamed roof. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

photos.caption: Heaters on mounting poles in the arched arcade. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.
A balcony table. Bromic-published photograph from the case study.

beats: The 5,500 sq ft, two-storey restaurant centers on wood-fired Santa Maria-style grilling, pairing black marble and tufted leather with wood beams, herringbone brick floors, rounded arches and a porch arcade.
Trust Restaurant Group wanted to respect the Spanish Colonial architecture while opening the dining room to San Clemente’s climate, with areas usable by day and at night.
Platinum Smart-Heat Electric heaters were chosen for their sleek look and installed in the semi-enclosed spaces, on hardwired On/Off switches, so the patios stay in use through the winter.
